{{Quote|Dug musicians blasted theme songs popularized by such past Malastarian Podracers as Sebulba and Ebe E. Endocott, Esq.|Extract from the HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|regional/13411_1.html|Moe Funeral Disrupted by Dug Activists}}</ref>}}
'''Esquire''' was a title of courtesy. It was usually placed after its bearer's surname in the abbreviated form '''Esq.''' [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe E. Endocott]], a famous [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] from [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]], held that title.<ref name="HNN51" /> [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]], Esquire was a well-respected [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Lawyer/Legends|advocate]] who was active in the reign of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and defended [[Tahiri Veila]] in her high-profile [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|trial]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>
